Question 21(a) [5 marks]: Describe the main features of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 5):
5 marks: Provides a detailed, accurate and relevant description of the focus in the context of the question | Communicates using appropriate historical terms and concepts
4 marks: Provides an accurate and relevant description of the focus in the context of the question | Communicates using appropriate terms and concepts
2–3 marks: Provides some relevant description of the focus in the context of the question | Communicates using some appropriate historical terms and concepts
1 marks: Makes a general statement relevant to the question

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
The 1964 Civil Rights Act was a landmark decision which ended segregation in public places and banned employment discrimination on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, and national origin.
